soundness_flags.label: prop:affine-rank-criterion
soundness_flags.one_line: The displayed rank condition is existential in a direction whereas the left side names a fixed v, and the construction omits the local-mechanism simplex/tangent constraint needed for theta+t v to remain an SCM.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Rewrite the affine proposition as: there exists a simplex-tangent rational v with Av=0 and bv≠0 iff rank([A;b])>rank(A); define A and b as gradients restricted to that tangent space.
Make the selected-bow proposition fully typed by fixing rho=(X,C), x=0, c=1, y=1, indexing all quantities by M_+ and M_-, and displaying the short selected-law calculation.

Before elevating the headline, prove or computationally falsify a residual-forest extraction lemma for a minimal all-fail terminal state; this is the genuine denominator-lock bottleneck rather than the already-settled sIDP and CIDP boundary.

recommended_next_step: Revise the two ill-posed supporting statements, retain the field-level conditional-completeness kernel, then advance the repaired core to Stage 0.
